description: Source file implementing utility functions for network management, including interface description loading, command execution, IP address validation, file handling, environment variable reading, and string validation.

classes.name: NetUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing network-related functions such as executing commands, IP validation, and configuration loading.

methods.name: InitialiseNetUtils
methods.description: Initializes network utilities by loading interface descriptions.

methods.name: _loadInterfaceDescriptions
methods.description: Loads interface descriptions based on environment variables.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescription
methods.description: Returns a description for a given network interface.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command, captures output, and optionally provides execution result status and output file.

methods.name: isIPV4
methods.description: Checks if an address is in IPv4 format.

methods.name: isIPV6
methods.description: Checks if an address is in IPv6 format.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file, optionally deleting it after reading.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the device properties file.

methods.name: getTmpFilename
methods.description: Generates a temporary filename based on a prefix and an internal counter.

methods.name: isIPV6LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is link-local.

methods.name: isIPV4LinkLocal
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is link-local.

methods.name: _isCharacterIllegal
methods.description: Helper function to identify illegal characters in endpoints.

methods.name: isValidEndpointURL
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid endpoint URL based on allowed characters.
